Identify subagent requests from the client

The executable's client constructor tags every request made outside
the main thread with the subagent id and, when there is one, its parent
agent id. thyrox already sent the session id but not these, so a proxy
could not tell a subagent's traffic from its parent's.

getAnthropicClient now sends x-thyrox-agent-id and
x-thyrox-parent-agent-id, encoded like the reference, taking the agent
context in progress when the caller passes none. The reference names
carry the product word the product-word gate rejects; the existing
session header is untouched.

Extraction with bin/binary and the annulment controls are in the
session-headers bench.
